description: Department of Census & Statistics - The National Consumer Price Index computed for the month of December, 2016 was 118.0
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for December 2016, as computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. The content is purely statistical and informational, relating to economic data reporting. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous administrative matters.
